title: Solkraftverk (solcellsparker) i Sverige
description: Solar power generation/storage units in Sweden (99 of 662), carved from sv-kraftverk by the native `fueltype` field. Verbatim subset of the powerplantmatching (PyPSA) merged European power plant dataset: name, technology, capacity (MW), efficiency, commissioning/retrofit/retirement year, coordinates, storage attributes and cross-referenced upstream source IDs.
